summary: Diff implements core PWA installability: adds a manifest and links it in index.html, adds a service worker with an offline fallback page and registers it at runtime (via App.tsx), and adds in-app install UI including iOS manual instructions. One notable gap is that the required icon image files themselves are not shown as added/updated in the diff summary (manifest references paths, but the actual PNGs are not evidenced).

missing_requirements.requirement: Provide the required PWA icon image assets: pwa-icon.dim_192x192.png, pwa-icon.dim_512x512.png, and pwa-icon-maskable.dim_512x512.png under the frontend public/static serving path.
missing_requirements.reason: The manifest references these icon paths, but the diff summary does not show the image files being added or modified, so their presence cannot be confirmed from the provided evidence.
